flags: Route discrepancy retained explicitly: state directions use US 441 via Sevierville and end at Elizabethton; TDOT’s brochure describes an endpoint at Watauga Lake. The supplied map follows US 321 via Townsend and onward to the lake. Do not present these as identical alignments.
The cache does not establish a byway designation date or campaign. Road history is specifically the Lenoir City highway and later river crossing, not the creation of the full byway.
Townsend’s article gives the lumber land sale as 1926; the railroad article gives an agreement in 1925. Retained the sale date without conflating agreement and conveyance.

No unsupported current moment claim was dropped. Removed the Elizabethton direction-sign detail for narrative focus; it is supported by the US 321 cache. No current festival schedule or operating access is promised beyond the documented recurring practice.
